preparationQualification: The first new diagnostic stopped before model inference because the RGB fitter returns a model/report pair. Tuple unpacking was corrected; the complete cohort was then run in a fresh output directory. The failed record is preserved.
architecture: Same frozen adapted U2NETP and the same three 1536-weight projections. At inference, fit balanced exposed-lobe RGB first; fit context channels to the remaining signed regression residual on those same samples. Sum RGB and context scores for overlap pixels. No overlap labels enter either per-photo fit.
fittingQualification: Sequential ridge is a different extrapolation bias, not an assurance that RGB cannot get worse. No neural updates or checkpoint selection occurred.

radial.camera: known synthetic camera; not automatic localization

newCases: Informative context recovers identity despite misleading ink colours
Finite-difference gradients through the residual ridge solve

observations: Residual readout reduces many false corner-cell holes and contour irregularities introduced by joint feature fitting.
The low-contrast gray/cream example still loses bottom/right cells; red/green JPEG boundaries remain noisy.
Printed stripes/flowers are better suppressed on average, but some cells remain distorted or split and individual regressions persist.

limitations: All radial examples are plain simulated paper with known camera corners; source allocation remains unassigned, and simplified routing topologies overlap existing families.
The 96-view comparison reuses training data. Its improvement is not unseen generalization.
Fractional synthetic coverage implies nonzero expected hard-label error even for ideal binary predictions.
No real-photo mask, crop, production NN, solver behavior or export threshold is changed by this prototype.
The full real-photo cohort and final exported-template checks remain required before any production decision.
next: Freeze these results, then evaluate residual readout on every existing real development photo with the same crops, retaining unresolved cases, and rerun full template fitting/export checks for a justified candidate. Do not deploy on synthetic averages alone.
